items.name: Motion Sense 60 feet
items.text: A vaultbreaker ooze can sense nearby motion through vibration and air movement.

items.name: Treasure Sense (Imprecise) 30 feet
items.text: The vaultbreaker ooze's metallic plasm alerts it to the presence of metals with the precious trait (including gold and platinum) within 30 feet.

items.name: Metallify
items.text:
Trigger A creature Strikes the vaultbreaker ooze

---

Effect The ooze's outer plasm hardens into a protective shell of precious metals. Until the start of its next turn, it gains resistance 5 to physical damage (except adamantine), it has a –5-foot penalty to its Speed, and its pseudopod Strikes gain the versatile S or P weapon trait.

items.name: Engulf
items.text:
DC 23 Reflex save, 2d8+9 acid damage, escape dc=23, Rupture 14 (19 when using Metallify)

---

items.name: Form Tool
items.text: The vaultbreaker ooze instinctually shapes its pseudopod into a key, lockpick, or tool required to bypass a locking mechanism; it uses this pseudopod as thieves' tools to pick-a-lock or disable-device.
